% !TeX program = lualatex
% The stress deck: a few slides with the stress-test template and its optional theme features switched on
% (mini frames, progress bar, divider frames, watermark), which the calibration deck leaves off so that
% tools/check_layout.py has the ordinary chrome to measure. It only has to compile, in all three deck versions.
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}

\makeatletter
\def\input@path{{../}}
\makeatother
\graphicspath{{../}}

\def\StressOptionalFeatures{}
\input{SlideMage_template_stress-test}

\newcommand{\FooterText}{Stress deck}

\ifdefined\deckversionoverride
	\deckversion[\deckversionoverride]
\else
	\deckversion[instructor]           % options: instructor, during-course, after-course
\fi
\decklanguage[en]

\begin{document}

	\slide{ZS1-EN-Stress-Title}
	\section{First section}
	\slide{ZS2-EN-Stress-List}
	\section{Second section}
	\slide{ZS3-EN-Stress-Reveal}

\end{document}
